description: Starter manifest for apps that already produce typed signals (coaching scores, assessments, tracked metrics) and need no LLM extraction. Send interaction_type=structured_patches with pre-typed patches[]; CQ validates against this manifest and stores atomically (whole batch accepted or rejected). Raw media/transcript fields (summary, content, messages, transcript) are rejected by the privacy gate — send structured signals only.
design_principles: The app owns signal quality; CQ owns memory lifecycle, series grouping, and recall.
Longitudinal types keep every observation (a trajectory), not just the latest value.
rating_ordinal-style scale fields are 1-indexed — validation rejects falsy required values.

A gap the coaching surfaced. Completable — close it when a later session shows the gap addressed.
patch_types.cue_guidance: Name the skill or behavior with the gap, so later sessions about that topic recall it.
